config.temperature: per learner and unit, validation NLL (L.fit_temperature), bounds [0.05, 20]
config.oracle: *_oracle fields refit T on the scored labels; reference only
config.T_oracle: T refitted on the test fold's NLL; T_oracle > T means the validation T under-corrects (the validation split also selected the checkpoint by F1)
config.contested: test instances on which the learners' predicted labels differ
config.T_ratio: contested.T_ratio is the mean within-unit max/min and includes the estimation noise of T; temperature.ratio_learner_means is max/min of the learner-mean T, with a noise-only reference from 5000 within-unit shuffles of the learner labels
config.conf_range: contested.conf_range_raw/ts: mean within-unit range of the learner mean c_m; conf_range_learner_means_raw/ts: range of the learner means
config.per_corpus_sd: per_corpus and per_corpus_pooled: SD over units (seeds) of the mean of the learners; sd_between_learners: SD of the learner means
config.ece_comparisons: per_learner: per test fold, compare only within it; per_learner_pooled and fusion: pooled out-of-fold predictions per seed (same n), for comparisons in domain; *_m fields: n_match = min(pooled source n, target n), the larger side averaged over 200 subsamples without replacement, for in domain vs corpus shift
config.ece_floor: mean plug-in ECE of a perfectly calibrated predictor with the same confidences and n (correctness ~ Bernoulli(confidence), 200 draws)
config.monte_carlo: size-matched ECEs and floors are means over N_SUB random draws; their Monte Carlo SD is about 0.0005 per learner and seed (one set of subsamples is shared by the learners of a seed or unit, so learner means do not average it away)
config.dece: debiased top-label L2-ECE (Kumar et al., 2019), 15 equal-width bins; an L2 quantity, not on the scale of the L1 ECE; slightly biased upward near 0 (clipping, square root)
config.inference: NLL and Brier differences: two-stage bootstrap percentile CI, p_boot, Holm; ECE differences descriptive only (rep_bias = mean replicate - point of the difference; ci95_basic = basic bootstrap CI)
config.multiplicity: pooled macro-F1: primary family Holm within corpus (p_holm) and over corpora (p_holm_all_corpora); other F1 tests exploratory, Holm within corpus; NLL and Brier Holm within corpus and metric over all pairs; p_boot = 0 means below 2/n_boot
config.equivalence: TOST on pooled macro-F1 for ['SA-WSV + TS vs SA-WSV (bootstrap)', 'SA-WSV w/o confidence vs SA-WSV (bootstrap)'] at margins [0.005, 0.01]: equivalent iff the 90% percentile CI lies inside (-delta, +delta); a claim for every corpus is an intersection-union test, so no correction
